verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe deduplication keys that stop duplicate alerts from being created while a matching alert is still active. A separate alert-grouping feature collects related alerts into a single alert group so they are triaged, escalated and attached to an incident once, which directly addresses one incident paging one human. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well dedup and grouping reduce paging noise in practice.
